description: This is a helper class for catalog-related operations in a sales management system. It provides static methods to filter product attributes by language and to set product availability based on locale.

classes.name: CatalogServiceHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with catalog product data filtering and availability setting.

methods.name: setToLanguage
methods.description: Filters product attribute descriptions to only include those matching the specified language ID.

methods.name: setToAvailability
methods.description: Adjusts the product's availability to include only the default and/or locale-specific availability options.
